title: Openings
prompt: Morning light through an open green-painted door in an old stone cottage, viewed from the quiet interior; beyond the threshold a garden path curves out of sight. A travel bag rests just inside. Suggest the instant before someone takes the first step into a story.

title: Endings
prompt: At the end of a day beside a small harbour, a woman in a muted green coat watches a departing passenger boat recede toward the horizon. A coiled mooring rope and an empty bench in foreground, soft rose dusk. A sense of completion with life continuing beyond the frame, not grief.

title: Feeling stuck
prompt: An adult writer sits thoughtfully at a modest wooden desk beside a window, a clean open notebook and idle pencil on the desk; outside, a climbing plant has found its way around a closed garden gate. Gentle afternoon light, a pause rather than despair, generous tranquil room details, notebook pages have no writing.

title: Time in fiction
prompt: A quiet old clockmaker's workshop with a large round clock face WITHOUT numbers or lettering, two simple clock hands; sunlight falls on an open unlabeled pocket watch on a desk. Through the window people cross an old town square. Dried and fresh flowers together hint at different rhythms of time; contemplative, coherent scene.

title: Clarity
prompt: A river landscape after morning mist, viewed from a small stone bridge. In foreground the shallow clear water reveals rounded pebbles; the path and a distant cottage emerge cleanly from thinning mist. Simple strong composition, lucid light, restrained details, a scene becoming understandable.

title: Editing
prompt: At a warm wooden table a thoughtful adult writer rearranges a few plain unlettered manuscript sheets beside a pencil and small eraser. A carefully pruned potted herb and a neat pile of offcuts nearby echo the act of removing excess. Side view, precise quiet work, no text on any page, no scissors, no contrived floating symbols.

title: Free writing
prompt: A lively but gentle stream flows freely out of woodland into an open sunlit meadow, bending around stones. At the grassy bank an open blank notebook and pencil sit beside a seated young adult, seen from behind, who watches the water. Sense of permission and momentum, airy expansive composition.

title: Metaphors and images
prompt: A poetic but physically plausible garden pond reflects a tree and drifting clouds; several pale fallen petals on the water resemble little boats. An adult sits quietly sketching beside the pond, face not detailed. Emphasise seeing one thing in another through reflections and shapes, no literal floating words or fantasy collage.

title: Location
prompt: A richly specific English village street bending downhill toward an estuary: weathered stone cottages, green doors, flowerpots, cobbles, a tiny shop with NO signage, distant hills and a single pedestrian. Show how place can carry a story through concrete sensory details, same refined watercolour style.

title: Character
prompt: An observant portrait within a scene: a mature Black woman in a sage coat seated in a quiet conservatory, looking toward an empty chair, holding a folded unmarked letter loosely in her lap. Around her a worn gardening glove, flowering plant, cup and old hat suggest a life through chosen details. Dignified, thoughtful, natural proportions, not close-up.

title: Plot
prompt: A traveller in a muted coat approaches a fork in an old woodland path: one branch crosses a small wooden footbridge toward a distant lit cottage, the other winds into deeper trees. A fallen branch partly blocks one route. Clear visual cause, obstacle, choice, and consequence, natural landscape with no signs or arrows.

title: Voice
prompt: A small diverse group of adults in a warmly lit library listening as an older South Asian woman tells a story, one subtle expressive gesture, everyone relaxed. View wide enough for shelves, green armchairs and dusk window. Convey an individual presence and cadence, not a classroom lecture; books have unlettered spines.

title: Theme
prompt: A garden through an open wrought-iron gate, where the same climbing rose appears as a small bud in the foreground, full blossoms along the arch, and scattered petals on the path. A person tends the plants in the middle distance. A recurring visual motif quietly connects the whole scene; unified natural setting, no diagram.
